description: This is a Perl script used for flashing a firmware onto a D-Link DSL-G6x4T device, involving network communication, device discovery, FTP interactions, and firmware transfer.

classes.name: ADAM2FTP
classes.description: A subclass of Net::FTP tailored for interacting with the ADAM2 device, including methods for getting environment variables and rebooting.

methods.name: _USER
methods.description: Sends the USER command to the FTP server.

methods.name: _GETENV
methods.description: Retrieves an environment variable from the FTP server.

methods.name: getenv
methods.description: Public interface to retrieve a specific environment variable.

methods.name: _REBOOT
methods.description: Sends the REBOOT command to the FTP server.

methods.name: reboot
methods.description: Reboots the device via FTP and closes the connection.
